completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "The pilot allowed the trike to exceed its critical angle of attack on final approach, and it entered an aerodynamic stall at too low an altitude to recover. [20220529105143:analysis] Strong, gusting winds increased the likelihood of a sudden increase in angle of attack as the pilot approached the runway at a slow speed, already near the critical angle of attack. [20220529105143:analysis] The stated cause was the pilot's failure to maintain proper airspeed and exceedance of the critical angle of attack, resulting in a stall while landing with gusting wind. [20220529105143:analysis] The trike then struck a tree and the ground near the approach end of the runway, and the pilot and passenger were fatally injured. [20220529105143:analysis][20220529105143:factual] Postaccident examination found no preimpact mechanical malfunctions or failures that would have precluded normal operation. [20220529105143:analysis]"}
